purpose: Continue the active three-session historical research goal after Campaign127 by reviewing a finite six-concept catalog against all 150 complete logical definitions before any Campaign128 source row, candidate value, comparator value, price or return is opened.

finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.name: intraday_transaction_price_dispersion_resolution_2h
finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.reason: It measures within-session convergence of the executed-price distribution, not close-return variance, whole-day transaction-price consensus, amount-clock shape or transaction-price skew. It uses the already accepted immutable minute source and requires no provider request.

finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.name: intraday_transaction_price_skew_resolution_2h
finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.reason: Morning-to-afternoon Bowley-skew change would be a direct temporal extension of the terminal full-day transaction-price Bowley-skew definition and creates a same-source statistic sweep.

finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.name: intraday_market_relative_transaction_price_dispersion_resolution_2h
finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.reason: Adding a market-relative residual introduces benchmark, peer-minimum and residualization choices after extensive market-state exposure; it is not a required part of the selected issuer-level distribution mechanism.

finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.name: intraday_transaction_price_dispersion_resolution_with_activity_filter
finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.reason: Conditioning or weighting the score by active-bar share would combine the new statistic with the terminal active-trading-bar mechanism and add a filter rescue path.

finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.name: intraday_amount_distribution_gini_concentration_240m
finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.reason: An orderless inequality statistic is an alternate concentration functional adjacent to terminal amount participation entropy; testing it here would be a concentration-measure sweep rather than a distinct information state.

finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.name: quarterly_transaction_price_resolution_confirmation_product
finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.reason: Multiplying the candidate by a quarterly state would combine exposed terminal factors and create post-hoc feature selection. Campaign128 remains a single unfitted historical factor.

selected_candidate.name: intraday_transaction_price_dispersion_resolution_2h
selected_candidate.economic_hypothesis: A volume-weighted executed-price distribution that narrows from morning to afternoon indicates price discovery convergence and reduced disagreement into the close, which may persist over the next three sessions.
